# Score attribution

Wonder Audio was extracted from the music engine in `team_lab3d`. Its synthesis, original arrangements, and six discovery phrases run locally without recordings or downloads.

The `NOCTURNE_OPENING` notation and its piano reduction in `audio.js` adapt the opening two bars of Frédéric Chopin's *Nocturne Op. 9 No. 2* from Renato Biolcati Rinaldi's Mutopia transcription:

- Source: https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=1590
- License: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/
- Changes: MIDI tuples for both hands, reduction to a repeating piano accompaniment, and timing expressed on a dotted-quarter pulse. The adapted notation is shared under CC BY-SA 3.0.

The opening four bars of Johann Sebastian Bach's *Prelude in C major, BWV 846* are reduced for the Bach accompaniment from Tobias Erbsland's public-domain Mutopia edition:

- Source: https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=5

The discovery phrases are original compositions. This notice preserves the existing score attribution; it does not grant a new license to the rest of the source code.

The Brubeck preview has an original 5/4 accompaniment and original discovery phrases. Its quartet instrumentation and odd-meter direction are inspired by Dave Brubeck's playing, described in his [official biography](https://www.davebrubeck.com/biography/).

## Metal preview

The Metal accompaniment and six discovery motifs are original compositions and use locally synthesized instruments. The requested Metallica reference guides the heavy-guitar direction; no song transcription, recording, or sample is included.

## Sky Castle preview

The Sky Castle accompaniment and discovery motifs are original compositions, inspired by the requested atmosphere of wonder and flight in Castle in the Sky. All instruments are synthesized locally; no film score transcription, recording, or sample is included.

## Platformer preview

The Platformer accompaniment and discovery motifs are original compositions inspired by the requested cheerful platform-game atmosphere. Pulse, triangle, and noise instruments are synthesized locally. No Mario melody, recording, sample, or game sound effect is included.

## Tchaikovsky preview

An original ballet-inspired orchestral waltz and six original discovery motifs. All instruments are synthesized locally; this is not a transcription of a Tchaikovsky score.

## Moonlight Ballad preview

An original romantic ballad and six original discovery motifs inspired by the requested mood of “The Moon Represents My Heart” (月亮代表我的心). No lyrics, song melody transcription, recordings, or samples are included. All instruments are synthesized locally.

## Bounce preview

An original instrumental accompaniment and six discovery motifs inspired by the requested playful, punchy hip-hop direction. No lyrics, vocals, song riff transcription, recordings, or samples from “The Real Slim Shady” are included. All instruments are synthesized locally.

## 高山流水 preview

An original guzheng-inspired composition and six original discovery motifs. The mountain/water contrast draws on the Zhejiang tradition described by the [China Cultural Centre in Kuala Lumpur](https://www.chinaculturalcentre.my/guzhengsoundofchinesefolkmusicep5/). It is not a transcription of a particular regional score or recording. All plucked strings are synthesized locally.
